name: BOXABL Inc.
summary: BOXABL is a modular construction and housing technology company that manufactures factory-built, rapidly deployable housing systems. The company's flagship product is the "Casita," a 361-square-foot studio home that includes a kitchen and bathroom and is designed to unfold on-site in under an hour. It is also developing stackable and connectable modular units to create larger single-family homes and multifamily buildings to address housing affordability and speed of construction.
